ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Via Excel Add-in - Registry
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect potential persistence via the creation of an excel add-in (XLL) file to make it run automatically when Excel is started. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Office\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\Excel\\\\Options$") AND Details = RGX("^\\/R\\ ") AND Details = RGX("\\\.xll$"))
